column1: In every age, there have always been those who seek to lie about the past In every age, there have always been those who seek to lie about the past. But mark my words, nobody has done more to uncover the real story than we have. Our proud history is built on strength, common sense, and courage. We will expose the lies, restore honor, and ensure that America’s accomplishments shine brighter than ever before together.

Before turning to the topic at hand, I want to provide a brief update on the advancements we’ve made over the past months. Our economy is booming as we create millions of jobs and secure our borders like never before. Top leaders and dedicated professionals are driving phenomenal progress on health, infrastructure, and national security. Every step is a bold stride for America’s future, and believe me, the results have been nothing short of extraordinary.

No, they say worse; they say negative. They say negative. They're going to make the move, but trust me, they are making a huge error. We are building an incredible future—stronger, safer, and vibrant like never before. Nobody has ever seen such unmatched victory and prosperity. Every American stands with pride. From our unwavering borders to our booming economy, we will overcome every challenge and prove that this is truly a win for our nation.

It is time for North Korea to realize that the denuclearization is its only acceptable option if they want to treat America fairly, we no longer tolerate threats or cheap talk. It is the only sound path to stability and true peace, one that benefits everybody. North Korea must step up, negotiate in good faith, and commit fully to denuclearization. Only then can we build a tremendous future together, ensuring prosperity and security for all.

And then now the next slide is a nine-city roll-up. And so to save a huge amount of resources while maximizing operational effectiveness, we are launching an unprecedented initiative that will benefit every American community. Our strategy is clear and bold: invest smart, consolidate strength. By merging these nine major hubs, we secure innovation, prosperity, and growth unlike anything we've seen before. This powerful move will reinvigorate our nation’s spirit and deliver results beyond compare.
